name: Maximum 4 Passengers per Tatkal Ticket
description: Indian Railways strictly limits Tatkal bookings to a maximum of 4 passengers per PNR. Groups larger than 4 must be coordinated across multiple PNRs.

name: Mandatory Primary Passenger Photo ID
description: At least one passenger on the e-ticket must carry an original government-approved photo identity proof during the journey. Failure results in penalty fares.

name: Non-Refundable Policy on Confirmed Tatkal
description: Confirmed Tatkal tickets are non-refundable upon cancellation, unless the train is cancelled or delayed by over 3 hours (requiring TDR filing before chart preparation).
source_note: Indian Railways Passenger Fare & Refund Rules 2015

name: Same-City Terminal Confusion Prevention
description: Detects if the selected departure or arrival station differs from the primary city terminus searched (e.g. NDLS vs NZM/DLI/ANVT in Delhi, or MMCT vs CSMT/BDTS/LTT in Mumbai).

name: Tatkal 1-Day Advance Window Sanity
description: Ensures the selected travel date matches the active Tatkal booking window (day prior to origin departure: AC at 10:00 AM, Non-AC at 11:00 AM). Blocks past dates.

name: Midnight-Crossing Departure Alert
description: Warns when a train departs between 23:30 and 00:30, where travelers frequently mix up calendar dates (e.g., 00:15 departure requires arriving at station the night before).

name: Ladies Quota Gender & Age Verification
description: Ladies quota is exclusively reserved for female passengers traveling alone or accompanied only by children below 12 years of age. Adult males are prohibited.
source_note: Indian Railways Ladies Quota Eligibility Guidelines

name: Senior Citizen Age Verification
description: Senior citizen quota and lower berth allocation require male passengers to be 60+ and female passengers to be 45+/58+ years of age.
source_note: IRCTC Concession & Lower Berth Allocation Rules

name: Duplicate Passenger Detection
description: Checks for identical passenger names and ages within the same booking draft, which causes IRCTC validation rejections.

name: Government ID Number Format Verification
description: Validates format of passenger IDs (e.g. 12-digit Aadhaar, 10-char alphanumeric PAN, or valid passport format) to prevent PRS rejection.
source_note: UIDAI / Income Tax / MEA Validation Standards

name: Passenger Name Format Hygiene
description: Ensures passenger names contain valid alphabetical characters with a minimum length of 2 characters and no numeric or punctuation symbols.
